abstract: This article focuses on testicular germ cell tumours (seminoma and non-seminoma) in terms of their incidence, aetiology, pathology, clinical presentation and staging. Management options (surgery, radiotherapy and chemotherapy) are discussed according to stage of disease and the presence of adverse prognostic factors.
abstract_ja: 本稿は精巣胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ)について、その発生頻度、病因、病理、臨床像、病期分類の観点から扱う。治療の選択肢(手術、放射線療法、化学療法)は、病期および予後不良因子の有無に応じて検討する。
